account.byCurrency.title: By currency
account.free.note: This money is yours and revocable: you can withdraw it at any time without giving a reason.
account.free.title: Free part
account.history.empty.body: The first record appears when your transfer arrives.
account.history.empty.title: No movements yet
account.history.note: A conversion is shown on two lines: the transfer currency debited and the deal currency credited, with the rate between them.
account.history.title: Account movements
account.locked.empty: Nothing is locked right now: the whole balance is free.
account.locked.note: This money is yours too, but it is locked to specific deals and cannot fund another one: the deal it is locked to may roll back, and then the money must return.
account.locked.title: Locked part
account.locked.untilPaused: No date yet: the clock on this deal is paused
account.source.note: Refunds and withdrawals go only here and only in your name. The refund address cannot be changed — it is the account the money came from.
account.source.title: Source account
account.subtitle: One account for all your deals in both roles. The free part and the locked part are shown separately — only the free part can fund your next purchase.
account.title: My account
account.withdraw.locked.reason: There is no free balance right now: all of it is locked to deals. Withdrawal opens as soon as a reservation is released or a settlement is done.
account.withdraw.noSource: There is nowhere to withdraw to yet: the source account appears after the first incoming payment. A refund can only go there.
account.withdraw.note: Withdrawals go only to {account} at {bank} and only in your name. A withdrawal has no other address — that is a safeguard, not a restriction.
account.withdraw.partial: You can withdraw the free part. The locked part becomes available when the deals below close.
archive.empty.body: Deals land here after settlement, and those where the settlement through the service was not done.
archive.empty.title: The archive is empty
archive.list.title: Closed deals
archive.subtitle: Closed deals and their documents, kept for the period required by law.
archive.title: Deal archive
assurance.ladder.heading: How strong your position is
assurance.ladder.note: You are at level {level} of {total}. The ladder shows where the money is and what can happen to it. This is not a payment guarantee.
assurance.level.A0.hint: The parties and the property are known. There is no money in the deal yet.
assurance.level.A1.hint: We verified the payer identity and the origin of the funds. There is no money in the deal yet.
assurance.level.A2.hint: The money exists but it is in the payer account and belongs to him. It is not tied to this deal yet. It is too early to file.
assurance.level.A3.hint: The amount is tied to this deal. The confirmation has a number that can be checked. The amount remains the payer property, but only you can receive it — or it returns to him.
assurance.level.A4.hint: The money went to your details. The settlement document is in the documents section.
assurance.limits: It does not promise registration and does not make registry or bank timelines ours. It does not remove the payer's right to revoke: we may not promise otherwise, such a promise would have no force.
assurance.limits.title: What this confirmation does not promise
assurance.outcomes.notRegistered.body: The reservation is released automatically, with no application and no decision of ours. The money stays with the payer.
assurance.outcomes.notRegistered.retry: The deal can be run again: the identity check is kept and property data is refreshed as of the new deal date.
assurance.outcomes.notRegistered.title: Registration not confirmed in time
assurance.outcomes.registered.body: Settlement is executed the same banking day. If the confirmation arrives after the banking day closes, then the next one. When the amount lands in your account is up to your bank.
assurance.outcomes.registered.title: Registration confirmed
assurance.outcomes.title: What happens in each of the two outcomes
assurance.state.frozen.subtitle: The money is in place and does not move. A check is under way; we will tell you as soon as it ends.
assurance.state.frozen.title: Operations on this deal are paused
assurance.state.heldThirdParty.subtitle: The incoming payment is held for a check and does not count as paid in. We will write when the review ends.
assurance.state.heldThirdParty.title: Funds are not deposited
assurance.state.notFunded.subtitle: There is no money in the deal yet. It is too early to file the documents.
assurance.state.notFunded.title: Funds are not deposited yet
assurance.state.onAccount.subtitle: The amount is on their account, but it remains their property and is revocable. The reservation is placed on filing day — filing before that is premature.
assurance.state.onAccount.title: The money is with the payer, not reserved yet
assurance.state.onAccountFx.subtitle: The money is in the payer account in the transfer currency. There is no reservation yet — it is too early to file.
assurance.state.onAccountFx.title: Funds deposited but not converted
assurance.state.overfunded.subtitle: The payer paid the deal amount in full. The reservation is set on the day the documents are filed.
assurance.state.overfunded.title: The amount is collected
assurance.state.partiallyFunded.subtitle: The payer did not pay the full amount. Until it is collected in full no reservation is set and it is too early to file.
assurance.state.partiallyFunded.title: Part of the amount is collected
assurance.state.payoutUnknown.subtitle: We do not resend it: that is the protection against a double payout. We will check the next business day statement and tell you ourselves.
assurance.state.payoutUnknown.title: Instruction sent, no bank response
assurance.state.refundInProgress.subtitl: The funds are being returned to the payer. The deal can be run again: the identity check is kept and property data is refreshed as of the new deal date.
assurance.state.refundInProgress.title: The settlement through the service was not done
assurance.state.refunded.subtitle: The funds returned to the payer. The deal can be run again: the identity check is kept and property data is refreshed as of the new deal date.
assurance.state.refunded.title: The settlement through the service was not done
assurance.state.releasePending.subtitle: You will receive {payout} to your verified details the same banking day.
assurance.state.releasePending.title: Registration confirmed, settlement in progress
assurance.state.released.subtitle: The money went to your verified details. The settlement document is in the documents section.
assurance.state.released.title: The settlement is done
assurance.state.releasedToAccount.subtit: The funds returned to the payer. The deal can be run again: the identity check is kept and property data is refreshed as of the new deal date.
assurance.state.releasedToAccount.title: The settlement through the service was not done
assurance.state.reserved.subtitle: The amount is reserved for this deal and is held in a nominee account at {bank}.
assurance.state.reserved.title: Funds are confirmed
assurance.state.rollbackInProgress.subti: The funds are being returned to the payer. The deal can be run again: the identity check is kept and property data is refreshed as of the new deal date.
assurance.state.rollbackInProgress.title: The settlement through the service was not done
assurance.state.submitted.subtitle: The application was accepted by the registry. Settlement is executed on the day the registry confirms the transfer of title.
assurance.state.submitted.title: Funds confirmed, documents filed
assurance.state.transferDeclared.subtitl: The payer says it was sent; the bank has not confirmed the credit yet.
assurance.state.transferDeclared.title: Transfer declared, not confirmed
assurance.state.unidentified.subtitle: A payment arrived that is not linked to this deal yet. It does not count as paid in.
assurance.state.unidentified.title: Funds are not deposited
assurance.verify.note: The confirmation number can be checked on the open page {verifyUrl}: without signing in, from any device. If someone showed you this confirmation on their screen, enter the number there yourself.
assurance.whereMoney.body: In a nominee account at {bank}. Not on our balance sheet: client money is held separately and is not used for obligations of other deals.
assurance.whereMoney.meaning: While the reservation holds, the amount is tied to this deal and goes to no one. It then has two paths: on confirmed registration it goes to you, less the fee; if the condition does not occur in time it goes back to the payer in full. There is no third path.
assurance.whereMoney.onRevoked: If the payer revokes the funds you learn of it at once — by email and in the cabinet, before anything changes on the card. That is exactly why we keep the window between filing and settlement short.
assurance.whereMoney.title: Where the money is
assurance.youReceive.note: The large figure shows what you receive, not the deal amount. If it does not match the contract, write to us before filing the documents, not after.
assurance.youReceive.payoutVerified: Payout details are verified and locked until settlement
assurance.youReceive.title: What you receive
banner.cooling.body: The settlement is paused for a cooling-off period. This is a safeguard: changing payout details right before settlement is the most common way money is stolen.
banner.cooling.title: The recipient is changing payout details
banner.coverage.body: Deals in progress are unaffected. Your funds are where they were and are not frozen.
banner.coverage.title: New deals are temporarily paused
banner.partial.body: The money state, the required action and the deadline are correct. One block failed to load and can be refreshed on its own.
banner.partial.title: Some data did not load
banner.quote.body: Lari amounts are being recalculated. You will see the new amount before you confirm anything, and nothing you entered is lost.
banner.quote.title: The rate lock has expired
deadline.consequence.refund: By then the money returns to your account with us. You can withdraw it to your bank right after that.
deadline.consequence.registration: If registration is not confirmed by then, the reservation is released automatically, the money stays with the payer, and the deal can be run again.
deadline.consequence.reserve: If the funds are not reserved by then, the money stays on your account and you can take it back.
deadline.consequence.review: By then we must finish the review. If we do not, the payment goes back to the sender.
deadline.consequence.settlement: By then the bank must confirm the transfer. Without confirmation we check the next business day statement and tell you ourselves.
deadline.consequence.topup: If the money does not arrive by then, the deal will not start and your funds stay with you.
deadline.heading: Deadline
deadline.none: There is no deadline yet: it appears once payment instructions are issued.
deadline.paused.compliance: Operations on this deal are paused for a check. Meanwhile the money does not move.
deadline.paused.registry: The registry is unavailable, so the deal clock is paused. Both sides see the same thing.
deadline.paused.remaining: When the clock stopped, {value} remained. We will name the new deadline once it resumes.
deadline.paused.title: The clock is paused
deal.action.heading: What is required from you now
deal.denied.body: The parties have changed. Your own movements on this deal are still visible under “My account”; write to us for anything else.
deal.denied.title: You no longer have access to this deal
deal.docs.watermarkNotice: Every document view is logged, and the document itself carries your identifier and the time you opened it.
deal.error.title: We could not show the state of this deal
deal.money.feeBreakdown.body: The settlement fee and the conversion spread are two different things. The fee is charged once on the deal amount. The spread appears only if the money arrived in another currency, and it is not returned on rollback: the conversion has already happened.
deal.money.heading: Money
deal.money.note.historical: A historical record: the obligation was closed after the retention period expired, and there is no amount to pay out or refund on this deal. We pull up the history by the deal number.
deal.money.note.settlement: The rounding remainder goes to the recipient. Fees are disclosed in full.
deal.money.quoteExpired: The rate lock window has expired, so we do not show lari amounts right now: showing a stale amount is worse than showing none. You will see the new one before you confirm anything.
deal.money.rollbackNote: The settlement arrangement fee is not charged: there was no settlement. If the money arrived in another currency and was already converted, the conversion fee is not returned — the conversion took place.
deal.money.sameCurrency: The transfer currency matches the deal currency — there was no conversion and no conversion fee was charged.

deal.paying.action.mismatch.reason: Funding is unavailable until the contract and the registry agree. This protects you: you should not pay for a property with the wrong area or the wrong owner.

deal.paying.revocation.label: your right
deal.paying.timeline.frozen.insert.detai: Case {caseId}. A person makes the decision; this state does not end by itself.
deal.paying.timeline.heldThirdParty.inse: The incoming payment of {amount} is held: the sender does not match you.
deal.paying.timeline.notFunded.detail: We issued the account details and the reference. We are waiting for your transfer.

deal.paying.timeline.partiallyFunded.det: {collected} of {required} collected. Send the rest with the same reference.

deal.paying.timeline.refunded.detail: The refund of {amount} was credited to the source account.
deal.paying.timeline.releasePending.deta: The registry confirmed the transfer of title on {date}. The field check passed.
deal.paying.timeline.released.detail: Settlement was executed on {date}. The settlement document is in the documents section.
deal.paying.timeline.releasedToAccount.d: The funds were credited back. Your identity check is kept — a repeat deal will not start from scratch. Property data will be refreshed as of its date.
deal.paying.timeline.reserved.detail: The reservation was set on {date}, confirmation {confirmationNo}.
Registration was not confirmed in time. The reservation is released and the money goes to your account in the service.
deal.paying.timeline.submitted.detail: Application {applicationNo} was filed on {date}. The registry, not we, sets the response time.
deal.paying.timeline.transferDeclared.de: You reported the transfer. There is no bank confirmation yet.
deal.paying.timeline.unidentified.insert: The incoming payment of {amount} could not be linked to this deal automatically. We are sorting it out by hand.
deal.paying.where.frozen.body: The money is in place and does not move. A check is under way, the case number is below. A person makes the decision; this state does not end by itself, and we will write as soon as the decision is made.
deal.paying.where.frozen.title: Operations on this deal are paused
deal.paying.where.heldThirdParty.body: It came from another person and was stopped — including a spouse, a parent or your own company, unless agreed in advance. The money is safe: we either credit it after the review or return it to the sender.
deal.paying.where.heldThirdParty.title: Transfer held: the sender is not you
deal.paying.where.notFunded.body: Until the transfer arrives nothing happens in the deal: no reservation, no filing.
deal.paying.where.notFunded.title: The money has not arrived yet
deal.paying.where.onAccount.body: The reservation is placed on the day documents are filed. Until then the money stays yours and you can withdraw it without giving a reason.
deal.paying.where.onAccount.title: In your account. You can withdraw at any time
deal.paying.where.onAccountFx.body: The money is yours and revocable. To move on, confirm the rate and the resulting lari amount — we convert nothing before you confirm.
deal.paying.where.onAccountFx.title: On your account, in the currency you sent
deal.paying.where.overfunded.body: Exactly the deal amount goes into the deal. The excess stays free on your account: it is not locked and you can withdraw it at any time.
deal.paying.where.overfunded.title: Your account holds more than the deal needs
deal.paying.where.partiallyFunded.body: Send the difference before the deadline below. If it is not collected, the deal will not start and what you sent stays on your account, ready to be withdrawn.
deal.paying.where.partiallyFunded.title: Your account holds less than the deal needs
deal.paying.where.payoutUnknown.body: We do not resend the instruction — that is the only way not to pay twice. We will check the next business day statement and tell you ourselves.
deal.paying.where.payoutUnknown.title: Instruction sent, no bank response
deal.paying.where.refundInProgress.body: Only to the source account and only in your name — a refund has no other address. Crediting usually takes one business day.
deal.paying.where.refundInProgress.title: The refund to your bank has been sent
deal.paying.where.refunded.body: The refund has been credited to the source account. The refund document is available with the deal documents.
deal.paying.where.refunded.title: The money is back in your bank
deal.paying.where.releasePending.body: The registry confirmed the transfer of title. Settlement is executed the same banking day; nothing is required from you.
deal.paying.where.releasePending.title: Registration confirmed, settlement in progress
deal.paying.where.released.body: The money is with the recipient and the deal is closed. Its documents stay available in this section.
deal.paying.where.released.title: The settlement is done
deal.paying.where.releasedToAccount.body: The settlement through the service was not done. The money is yours and revocable again. Two equal paths from here: withdraw it to the source account or run the deal again.
deal.paying.where.reserved.body: The money is in a nominee account at {bank}: not with the recipient and not on our balance sheet. The withdrawal button is closed while the reservation holds.
deal.paying.where.reserved.revocation: Until the transfer of title is registered in the registry the money stays yours: you are entitled to revoke it. A revocation is arranged through us, and the recipient learns of it at once.
deal.paying.where.reserved.title: Reserved for this deal
deal.paying.where.rollbackInProgress.bod: Registration was not confirmed in time. The settlement condition did not occur, so the reservation is released. The money returns to your account in the service, not to your bank: from there you can withdraw it or run the deal again.
deal.paying.where.rollbackInProgress.tit: The reservation is released: the money is coming back to you
deal.paying.where.submitted.body: We are waiting for the registry to confirm registration. The reservation holds until the deadline below; nothing is required from you.
deal.paying.where.submitted.revocation: Until the transfer of title is registered in the registry the money stays yours: you are entitled to revoke it. Filing the documents does not transfer the title.
deal.paying.where.submitted.title: Reserved, documents filed
deal.paying.where.transferDeclared.body: Crediting usually takes one business day. We will write as soon as the money lands — you do not need to watch it.
deal.paying.where.transferDeclared.title: Transfer sent, waiting for it to arrive
deal.paying.where.unidentified.body: It came without a recognised reference, so it is not credited to the deal and does not count as your balance. We are sorting it out by hand, usually within one business day.
deal.paying.where.unidentified.title: A payment arrived but was not identified

deals.empty.body: A deal is opened by an operator once the parties and the property are checked. Meanwhile you can pass identity verification — it is done once and covers every future deal in any role.
deals.empty.step.1: You tell us the property and the amount
deals.empty.step.2: An operator creates the deal and matches the property against the registry
deals.empty.step.4: Only after that is money needed

deals.noDeadline: No deadline: the deal is closed
deals.roleNote.body: You never choose who you are right now. Selling in Batumi and buying in Tbilisi, you remain one client with one identity check and one account. Only the deal screen differs: a payer sees top-up details, a recipient sees payout details, never the other way round.
deals.roleNote.title: one cabinet, the role belongs to the deal
deals.subtitle: {name}, this is every deal of yours — the ones you pay for and the ones you are paid for. The role is written on each.

newDeal.role.question: What is your role in this deal?

notifications.item.reserved.title: Funds reserved for the deal
notifications.list.title: Latest
notifications.rule.body: A notification never contains account details and never leads straight into an action — only to the deal screen. If a message asks you to send money to a different account, it is not us.
notifications.rule.title: what will never be here
notifications.subtitle: Everything we told you is here. An email may not arrive or may be forged — this list is the real one.
notifications.title: Notifications
ops.basis.audit: The log is not edited. A correction is only a new entry referring to the previous one.
ops.basis.note: A decision without evidence is indistinguishable from a guess. The record keeps the policy version in force at that moment and the list of reasons: two years later it is what shows which rules applied.
ops.basis.title: What backs the decision
ops.breach.body: New deals are stopped automatically. This review comes first; everything else waits.
ops.breach.title: Client funds coverage is breached
ops.cannot.body: An operator cannot change the amount, the recipient details or the tranche state directly, and cannot approve a payout they prepared themselves. These buttons are absent not because they were hidden — such transitions do not exist in the state machine.
ops.cannot.title: what the console cannot do
ops.closing.rule.dualControl.note: Whoever caused the break does not lift it. The second employee is not the same person under another account: people are compared, not accounts.
ops.closing.rule.quorum: Two approvals: level one and level two
ops.closing.rule.quorum.note: There are only two levels, and no role gives both. Two different accounts approve, and neither of them prepared the operation. There is nowhere to take a third signature from.
ops.closing.rule.singleWithRecord: One person closes it, the record is required
ops.closing.rule.singleWithRecord.note: The rule requires no second approval, but the decision keeps the policy version, the reasons and the evidence. A decision without a record is indistinguishable from no decision.
ops.closing.rule.thresholdSecond: A second is needed above the amount threshold
ops.closing.rule.thresholdSecond.note: Below the threshold there is no second approval at all — there is nothing to ask about. Above it, the second must exist and be found. A reference to the grounds is required in both cases.
ops.closing.title: Who closes the task
ops.coverage.note: Balances on the accounts divided by liabilities to clients. The target is strictly one; any deviation stops new deals automatically.
ops.coverage.title: Client funds coverage
ops.decision.automation.note: The oracle establishes the condition, not the operator: the condition type has a closed list of external facts and cannot be set by hand.
ops.decision.automation.title: What automation did
ops.decision.evidence.note: Without the bundle there is no payout: the check stands both at the entry into settlement and at sending the instruction.
ops.decision.evidence.title: Evidence bundle
ops.decision.fields.note: One mismatch out of five blocks the payout. Four matches do not outweigh it: the check looks at all five fields, not at a majority.
ops.decision.fields.title: Matching of five fields
ops.decision.fourEyes.title: Four eyes
ops.decision.missing.title: What is missing for the payout
ops.decision.send.blocked: Unavailable: two checks do not pass. The button appears once both are closed.
ops.decision.subtitle: The console is a desk of exceptions. A tranche lands here only when automation could not complete it.
ops.decision.title: Payout decision
ops.decision.why.body: The oracle received the extract and matched five fields automatically. Four matched, the encumbrances did not — automation stopped there and handed the tranche to a human. Had all five matched, settlement would already be done.
ops.decision.why.title: why this is on your desk
ops.detail.missing.body: The decision frame is in place: outcomes, grounds and the closing rule are named. The data the decision is built on is not served by this layer yet — this is a visible state, not a blank page.
ops.detail.missing.title: The review materials are not here yet
ops.duty.breaks.note: open breaks at the end of the banking day
ops.duty.overdue.note: tasks whose deadline has already passed
ops.duty.subtitle: Five numbers looked at every morning. There is no work here: work lives in the queue. Here is only what is looked at as a whole.
ops.duty.title: Duty board
ops.duty.unknown.note: payouts with no match in the statement; the only way out is reconciliation
ops.duty.withoutDeadline.note: deals without a deadline out of {total} live ones
ops.empty.body: This is a good state, not a failure: everything that needed a person is done. The nearest deadline and the coverage are above.
ops.empty.title: The queue is empty
ops.emptyFilter.body: This is a filter result, not an empty queue. Reset the filter to see the other tasks.
ops.emptyFilter.title: Nothing matches the filter
ops.fact.subject: Subject
ops.facts.note: The facts are computed by the detector and do not form a decision: a person makes the decision and stores it with the policy version, the reasons and the evidence.
ops.facts.title: Review: the facts
ops.filter.label: Filter by task type
ops.guard.g_approvals_sufficient: The second approval is not collected
ops.guard.g_fields_match: The field mismatch is not resolved
ops.metric.coverage.note: currencies with coverage equal to one, out of the total
ops.metric.humanRequired.note: a blocked settlement, a second approval above the amount threshold, choosing the unfreeze target
ops.metric.waitingFact.note: the registry or a bank statement
ops.metric.waitingHuman.note: the decision depends on a person
ops.mobileNote: On a phone the console shows only what is genuinely needed at night: payout approval and the duty metrics.
ops.mobileStub: This task opens on a desktop: the review needs documents and a second check. On a phone only payout approval and the duty metrics are available — enough to decide at night.
ops.money.frozen.label: M-18 · Suspended
ops.money.frozen.note: Movement on the tranche is forbidden. There is no automatic exit: only a human decision — back to the previous state or a refund to the payer. A limited reason is disclosed to the client.
ops.money.heldThirdParty.label: M-04 · Held: third party
ops.money.heldThirdParty.note: The sender does not match the payer of the deal. Crediting is forbidden until compliance decides. Outcomes: credit with a reason, or return to the sender source account. Details are not disclosed to the recipient.
ops.money.notFunded.label: M-01 · Not funded
ops.money.notFunded.note: Instructions issued, no incoming payment. When the top-up deadline expires the deal rolls back automatically.
ops.money.onAccount.label: M-06 · On the client account
ops.money.onAccount.note: The tranche is collected in the deal currency, free, and withdrawal by the payer is allowed. The reservation is set on the filing day, not earlier.
ops.money.onAccountFx.label: M-05 · On account, transfer currency
ops.money.onAccountFx.note: The tranche is collected in the transfer currency. No reservation before conversion; conversion only at a rate confirmed by the payer.
ops.money.overfunded.label: M-08 · Overpayment
ops.money.overfunded.note: The tranche is credited exactly with the required amount; the excess goes to the free part of the client account immediately. Holding the excess until the deal closes is not allowed. The excess is withdrawn only to the source account.
ops.money.partiallyFunded.label: M-07 · Shortfall
ops.money.partiallyFunded.note: Less than required was collected, the shortfall is beyond tolerance. Reservation is forbidden until the full amount. When the top-up deadline expires the deal rolls back and the funds stay on the client account.
ops.money.payoutUnknown.label: M-13 · Outcome unknown
ops.money.payoutUnknown.note: Resending is forbidden. The only way out is reconciliation against the statement, not a timer. Duty metric: payouts in «unknown» for more than a day.
ops.money.refundInProgress.label: M-16 · Refund sent
ops.money.refundInProgress.note: A refund goes only to the source account and only in the payer name. If the source account is unknown the refund is not sent: a block is placed and a task is created.
ops.money.refunded.label: M-17 · Refunded
ops.money.refunded.note: A terminal state. The bank confirmed the credit to the source account and the obligation to the client is closed.
ops.money.releasePending.label: M-11 · Ready for settlement
ops.money.releasePending.note: The condition is established, revocation is no longer accepted. A payout requires a reference to the evidence bundle and the required number of approvals from different accounts. There is no «pay out» button.
ops.money.released.label: M-12 · Paid out
ops.money.released.note: A terminal tranche state. The bank confirmed execution, the postings are closed, and the fee was moved to the operating account in the same journal.
ops.money.releasedToAccount.label: M-15 · Funds released
ops.money.releasedToAccount.note: The tranche is closed, the funds are in the free part of the client account and withdrawal is allowed. A repeat deal reuses the checks: a new tranche, the same client.
ops.money.reserved.label: M-09 · Reserved
ops.money.reserved.note: The tranche is reserved and a confirmation was issued. A payer revocation is accepted. The recipient details are locked. When the filing deadline expires the rollback is automatic.
ops.money.rollbackInProgress.label: M-14 · Rollback
ops.money.rollbackInProgress.note: The condition did not occur by the deadline. The rollback is automatic and requires no human decision. The settlement fee is not charged; the conversion fee was withheld if a conversion took place.
ops.money.submitted.label: M-10 · Filed
ops.money.submitted.note: The tranche is reserved, the application is with the registry. A payer revocation is still accepted. If the registry is unavailable the clock pauses, the deadline is not skipped.
ops.money.transferDeclared.label: M-02 · Transfer declared
ops.money.transferDeclared.note: A statement by the party, not a bank event. Neither the reservation nor the recipient notice is built on it. We wait for the statement.
ops.money.unidentified.label: M-03 · Unidentified
ops.money.unidentified.note: Funds are on suspense and not allocated to the tranche. Crediting by guess is forbidden. When the review deadline expires the money goes back to the sender, it is not credited.
ops.next.approvePayout: After the second approval the instruction goes to the bank and the tranche moves into execution. While approvals are short, nothing happens: there is no «pay out» button in the system.
ops.next.beneficiaryChange: An applied change does not inherit the status of the previous details: the ownership evidence belonged to another account. Both parties learn about the change, through every channel and at the same moment.
ops.next.confirmRegistration: A confirmed registration opens settlement: next the evidence package is assembled and approvals are collected. A mismatch sends the tranche into a block whose exit depends on a person.
ops.next.flipping: A stop calls for a separate assessment for a report to the supervisor. A review does not stop the operation: the observation stays in the decision and comes up again on the next deal for the same property.
ops.next.intakeUnderpayment: A top-up in time completes the tranche and returns the deal to its normal course. If the deadline passes, the money stays on the client account and goes back to the source account: the default state on inaction is a refund.
ops.next.linkage: A hold keeps the money apart from the deal until a decision. A review does not stop it. A linkage signal by itself neither closes the deal nor is disclosed to the other side.
ops.next.matchPayment: A matched receipt becomes the client's money and is then allocated within the deal. An unmatched one, once the review deadline passes, goes back to the sender rather than being credited.
ops.next.payerException: A confirmed exception leaves the money on the client account and returns the deal to its normal course. A failed one means a hold: a third-party payment is not credited to the deal at any amount.
ops.next.priceMismatch: A stop leads to a separate assessment for a report to the supervisor. A request to state a different amount closes the operation with a refusal: the platform does not run two prices for one deal.
ops.next.relatedParties: The enhanced verification runs on both sides and cancels none of the usual ones. The same identity on both sides closes the deal with a refusal, and that is the only refusal here.
ops.next.releaseBlock: Crediting with a justification returns the tranche to its normal course. A return goes only to the source account and only to the payer's name. In both cases the details are not disclosed to the payee.
ops.next.reviewBreak: A match found in the statement closes the payout as settled, its absence as rejected. There is no third outcome, and re-sending the instruction from this state is forbidden.
ops.next.reviewSanction: The outcome goes to both sides in one message and at one moment. The target of the lift is recorded as a required field of the event: the review took time, and «as it was» cannot be restored.
ops.next.reviewSof: A passed check lifts the hold and the money moves on within the deal. A rejection keeps it held and leads to a return to the sender: the default state on inaction is a return.
ops.next.sanctionsUnavailable: When the provider answers, the screening is computed again and the task moves to "waiting for you" on its own. The hold is lifted by a screening result, not by the wait running out.
ops.next.structuring: The review does not stop the operation: the money moves on through the deal and the decision with its reasons stays in the log. The cluster found is taken into account for the next payments from the same payer.
ops.next.title: What happens next
ops.next.verifyClient: A passed check opens the acceptance of money for the deal. A rejection closes the deal before it starts: money already received goes back to the source account.
ops.outcome.absentFromStatement.body: The payout closes as rejected. The money stays on the nominal holding account and a new instruction is prepared for the tranche — a new one, not a repeat.
ops.outcome.absentFromStatement.title: No match in the statement
ops.outcome.approveBeneficiaryChange.bod: Your approval counts as one, and only if you did not file the request. The change applies when all four conditions hold at once, and not a minute earlier.
ops.outcome.approvePayout.body: Your approval counts as one. Execution starts when the required number of approvals from different accounts is collected, and not a minute earlier.
ops.outcome.approvePayout.title: Approve the payout
ops.outcome.awaitTopUp.body: The money stays in the free part of the client account and the tranche stays collecting. Payments accumulate, and the tolerance is measured on the accumulated total against the required amount, not on each payment.
ops.outcome.awaitTopUp.title: Wait for a top-up
ops.outcome.block.body: The operation is rejected. The money, if it has arrived, goes back to the source account.
ops.outcome.block.title: Reject
ops.outcome.blockRelease.body: Settlement stops and the tranche goes into the queue with priority by amount. It is the only state whose exit depends on a person — which is why its norm is the shortest.
ops.outcome.blockRelease.title: Send to block
ops.outcome.clear.body: There are no signals, the operation continues without restrictions.
ops.outcome.clear.title: Nothing triggered
ops.outcome.confirmWithDocument.body: A manual confirmation is accepted only with a document attached. The condition is established by an external fact, not by the operator's judgement.
ops.outcome.confirmWithDocument.title: Confirm with a document
ops.outcome.creditWithJustification.body: The money is recognised as the payer's money under the deal. The justification is attached to the decision and stays in the log for good.
ops.outcome.foundInStatement.body: The payout closes as settled: the bank did make it, only the answer never arrived. The postings close in the same journal.
ops.outcome.foundInStatement.title: Match found in the statement
ops.outcome.hold.body: The money is not credited to the deal and stays apart until a decision.
ops.outcome.hold.title: Hold the funds
ops.outcome.matchToDeal.body: A reference to the grounds is required: without it the match is no different from a guess. Above the amount threshold a second employee is needed.
ops.outcome.matchToDeal.title: Allocate to the deal
ops.outcome.recordMismatch.body: One mismatch out of five fields stops settlement. Four matches do not outweigh it: the check looks at all five, not at the majority.
ops.outcome.recordMismatch.title: Record the mismatch
ops.outcome.returnToSender.body: The return goes to the source account and to the payer's name. A return has no other address; if the source account is unknown, it is not sent.
ops.outcome.returnToSender.title: Return to the sender
ops.outcome.review.body: The task stays in the queue, the operation continues, the money is not held.
ops.outcome.review.title: Review without stopping
ops.outcome.shortfallAbsorbed.body: The tranche is credited for the required amount and the platform recognises the difference. This closes only correspondent deductions: the cause is established from the payment details, not from the size of the gap.
ops.outcome.shortfallAbsorbed.title: Shortfall within tolerance
ops.outcome.stop.body: The operation stops, and the need to report to the supervisory authority is assessed separately.
ops.outcome.stop.title: Stop the operation
ops.outcomes.title: What you decide
ops.payout.blocked.samePreparer: You prepared this operation. Another account approves it.
ops.payout.unknown.note: There is no repeat button here and there will not be one: repeating without reconciliation risks paying twice. The only way is reconciliation against the statement.
ops.recon.breaks.title: Break queue
ops.recon.coverage.note: At the end of the banking day, the target is strictly one.
ops.recon.coverage.title: client funds coverage
ops.recon.journal.note: A zero total is a visible invariant, not a caption. A journal that does not sum to zero is not saved.
ops.recon.journal.title: Posting journal
ops.recon.subtitle: Client funds coverage at the end of the banking day equals one. A deviation stops accepting new deals.
ops.recon.title: Reconciliation and coverage
ops.shelf.claimed.note: Two people do not take one task: this is protection against a double decision. If a task stays here past the norm, raise it to the duty officer.
ops.shelf.claimed.title: Taken by someone else
ops.shelf.fact.note: A registry answer or a bank statement. There is nothing to decide yet: a person is needed after the fact, not now. They are visible so they are not lost, not so they are opened again and again.
ops.shelf.fact.title: Waiting for an external fact
ops.shelf.human.note: Here the decision depends on a person. Until you decide, nothing happens: automation has stopped on these.
ops.shelf.human.title: Waiting for you
ops.subtitle: This is a work queue, not a list of deals. The system computes the priority: deadline first, then amount. There is nothing to configure.
ops.task.approve.note: There is no “pay out” button: execution starts when enough approvals from different accounts are collected.
ops.task.blocked.samePreparer: Approval is impossible for whoever prepared the operation or changed the payout details on this deal.
ops.task.claimedBy: Task claimed by {operator}. Two people do not work one task: that is the protection against a double decision.
ops.task.subject.title: What the task is about
ops.title: What needs me now
ops.unfreeze.bothSides: Both sides receive the same message at the same moment.
ops.unfreeze.cta.blocked: Waiting for the second approval: two different staff members are required.
ops.unfreeze.decision.title: The decision
ops.unfreeze.subtitle: Lifting does not restore the state «as it was»: the suspension lasted, and the choice between settlement and refund is a human decision that must be recorded.
ops.unfreeze.target.refund_pending.body: The deal will not be executed. The refund goes only to the source account, and that is a mandatory condition.
ops.unfreeze.target.refund_pending.title: Return the money to the payer
ops.unfreeze.target.release_blocked.body: The suspension is lifted but the review continues: the tranche goes into the regular operator queue prioritised by amount.
ops.unfreeze.target.suspended_from.body: The review is over and there are no grounds to stop the deal. The tranche returns where it stopped and settlement continues.
ops.unfreeze.target.suspended_from.title: Return to settlement
ops.unfreeze.targets.title: The target of lifting
ops.unfreeze.title: Lifting the suspension
ops.wait.label: what we are waiting for
ops.wait.registry.body: The filing is in, the filing card or the extract has not arrived. Until the registry answers there is nothing to establish the condition with: the list of external facts is closed and the condition cannot be set by hand.
ops.wait.registry.next: When the extract arrives the task moves to «waiting for you» on its own. If the registry is unavailable the clock stops, and both sides see the same thing.
ops.wait.registry.title: Waiting for the registry
ops.wait.screening.body: The request went to the provider and there is no answer. "Nothing found" and "could not look" are different answers, and the second one reads as a hold. It cannot be read as clear at any amount.
ops.wait.screening.next: The provider answer recomputes the screening and the task moves to "waiting for you" on its own. Until it arrives the money does not go to the deal, while the deal deadlines keep running.
ops.wait.screening.title: Waiting for the screening answer
ops.wait.statement.body: There is no bank answer on the instruction. It cannot be re-sent: there is no transition from «outcome unknown» back to sent, and re-sending without reconciliation risks paying twice.
ops.wait.statement.next: There is one way out: reconciling the next banking day's statement. It closes the task either as settled or as rejected — and a person does that, not a timer.
ops.wait.statement.title: Waiting for the bank statement
ops.why.approvePayout: The oracle received the extract and compared five fields automatically. Four matched, the encumbrances did not — automation stopped there and handed the tranche to a person. Had all five matched, settlement would already be done.
ops.why.beneficiaryChange: A party asks to change the payout details. Four conditions are checked together: holder re-verification, cooling-off, notice to both parties and a second approval. The pre-settlement window is checked again at the moment of applying.
ops.why.confirmRegistration: The filing is in the registry. Automation is waiting for the filing card and the extract; registration can be confirmed earlier only by hand and only with a document attached.
ops.why.flipping: The same property changed hands recently and the price jumped. The jump is measured against the previous transfer price, not against the market. A quick resale is lawful in itself: it is reviewed, not rejected.
ops.why.intakeUnderpayment: Less arrived than required and the gap went beyond tolerance. The tranche stays collecting, the money sits in the free part of the client account and is not credited to the deal. The party sees the missing amount, and the operator must see the task.
ops.why.linkage: The parties share a signal: an account, a device, a network address or a phone. A shared account raises the outcome to a hold, other signals to a review. A shared signal alone is not a refusal.
ops.why.matchPayment: The receipt arrived but is not allocated to a deal: the reference was not recognised, or there is more than one candidate. The money sits apart and is not counted as the deal's balance. It cannot be credited by guess.
ops.why.payerException: The payer is not the party but a close relative or a legal entity it controls. The list of such exceptions is closed and each one is backed by a document. The money goes to the client account, but a person must see the exception.
ops.why.priceMismatch: The amount going through the platform differs from the contract price beyond tolerance. What tells the cases apart is the cause, not the size of the gap. The automation stops the operation and separately assesses whether a report to the supervisor is due.
ops.why.relatedParties: Related parties stand on both sides of one deal. This is enhanced verification, not a refusal: such deals do happen for real. There is exactly one refusal here and it is about something else — the same person on both sides.
ops.why.releaseBlock: The sender does not match the payer of the deal. The money did arrive, but no obligation towards the payer arose from it. Crediting is stopped until a person decides.
ops.why.reviewBreak: The bank did not answer on the instruction. Automation took the tranche as far as dispatch and stopped: the machine has no transition from «outcome unknown» back to sent. The task is closed by reconciling the statement, not by time.
ops.why.reviewSanction: Operations on the deal are suspended. There is no automatic way out of a suspension: where the tranche returns — to settlement or to a return — is decided by a person, and that decision must be recorded.
ops.why.reviewSof: The source of funds was not confirmed automatically. The rule: a confirmed source covers at least nine tenths of the amount and links the payer's name to the movement of money.
ops.why.sanctionsUnavailable: The sanctions screening provider did not answer. No answer is not read as "nothing found": the funds stay on hold until it arrives. Until then there is nothing to decide.
ops.why.structuring: One payer made several payments inside one window, each below the threshold and together above it. The operation still continues: structuring is a reason to review, not to hold.
ops.why.verifyClient: Identity verification did not close automatically. The deal goes no further: with the person not established, money can neither be accepted nor paid out.
owner.conversion.note: The markup sits on top of the actual cost of conversion and is not the whole spread: part of the spread goes to the currency counterparty, and that is our cost, not our income.
owner.currencies.body: When a deal gains a second currency it has two economics, not one: turnover in one currency, costs in another. A single margin for such a deal does not exist, and showing one would be a fiction.
owner.currencies.title: There is no all currency total
owner.deal.economics.title: Economics in {currency}
owner.deal.expected.body: The deal is not finished. Below is the fact as of today: costs are incurred, revenue is not yet recognised. The expected fee is a separate line and is not a fact.
owner.deal.expected.title: Not the final result
owner.deal.head.note: The pricing version is fixed in the accrual entry and never changes retroactively: a deal is priced by the version in force when it was opened.
owner.deal.head.title: The deal
owner.deal.title: Deal {ref}
owner.deals.empty.body: Economics appears with the first deal: there is nothing to compute it from yet.
owner.deals.empty.title: No deals yet
owner.deals.list.note: The line shows the margin in the first currency of the deal. A second currency is not in the line: they cannot be added, and showing one without its code would be a lie. The full breakdown is on the deal card.
owner.deals.list.title: Deals by margin
owner.deals.subtitle: What each deal earned and what it cost. The list is sorted by margin ascending: the loss making deal comes first, because that is the one to talk about.
owner.deals.title: Deal economics
owner.expense.note: There are as many lines as there are expense accounts in the books. Man hours, irrecoverable VAT and partner commission are not here: there are no accounts for them, and adding them outside the books is not allowed.
owner.fee.note: Three states are three accounts, not a flag on one posting. A fee withheld from the payment but not transferred to the operating account must be visible as not transferred.
owner.legal.label: Basis
owner.legal.source: Every figure comes from the journal of postings. There is no separate economics table: a calculation that can drift from the books is not a calculation.
owner.limits.body: The owner does not approve payouts and does not work the exception queue: approval exists only while approvers are independent of whoever the margin is counted for. The reverse rule holds too — the operational role does not see company money.
owner.limits.title: What the owner does not do
owner.metric.currencies.note: Each currency has its own line. A single «all in» figure exists nowhere, this screen included.
owner.metric.deals.note: Every deal that moved in the period counts: settled, live and rolled back alike.
owner.metric.settled.note: Turnover and the average deal are computed on these only: an unfinished deal has no cheque yet.
owner.period.label: Period
owner.significance.gelOnly: Only lari turnover is in this figure: turnovers in different currencies are not added up, and the threshold is stated in lari. So the figure is knowingly understated, and the rule for converting foreign turnover is the owner decision, not ours.
owner.significance.note: The threshold is stated as an average monthly volume of 9,000,000 lari. Beyond it come capital requirements for the provider and a separate supervisory regime.
owner.significance.title: Provider significance threshold
owner.significance.warn.body: You are at {value} of the threshold. Beyond it capital requirements and the significant provider regime switch on. That crossing is planned in advance, not discovered after the fact.
owner.significance.warn.title: The threshold is close
owner.summary.currency.note: The lines of this card add up with each other and with nothing else: lari and dollars cannot be added, a rate is an external fact of a date, not a property of a report.
owner.summary.currency.title: {currency}: turnover and margin
owner.summary.empty.body: This is a zero, not missing data. The period is chosen above, and not a single deal closed in it.
owner.summary.empty.title: No deals in this period
owner.summary.subtitle: Turnover, revenue on both legs, cost and margin for the period. All of it is computed from the journal: there is no separate economics table.
owner.summary.title: How things are going
owner.tariff.ceiling.note: The ceiling applies to the sum of all withholdings, not to a single line: a ceiling on a line is bypassed by adding a line. It is there against a typo in a percentage, not against bad faith.
owner.tariff.change.action: Change the rate and the markup
owner.tariff.change.reason: Not available: there is no pricing plan version in the system yet, and without one a change would reprice deals that are already open.
owner.tariff.change.title: Changing the tariff
owner.tariff.change.versioning: Once versions exist, a change will apply from the next deal, land in the audit log with an author and a time, and deals already open will stay on their own version for ever.
owner.tariff.fee.title: Settlement fee
owner.tariff.fx.note: The cost of conversion today is larger than our markup: by the measured retail rate the currency leg costs more than the economics assumed. Until a dealer rate source is found, no markup rate is justified.
owner.tariff.fx.order: Read it in order: the official rate, minus what the counterparty took, minus our markup, and what is left is the price to the client. The markup is the third line on purpose — it sits on top of the cost, not instead of it.
owner.tariff.fx.title: Conversion: what it is made of
owner.tariff.legal.notice: A planned change to framework contract terms requires a month of notice, and the rule has no carve out for pricing. So a markup named as a number in the contract cannot be moved faster than a month.
owner.tariff.payer.derived: This value is derived from how settlement is built, not read from a setting: the fee is withheld from the tranche amount, so the recipient bears it. A setting with this meaning does not exist in the system yet.
owner.tariff.payer.title: Who pays the fee
owner.tariff.payer.vat: A consequence with money in it: by the tax analysis the input VAT deduction appears when a non resident pays the fee. That is about seventy per cent of the deduction, so changing the payer is not cosmetic.
owner.tariff.quote.note: A quote is voided when the market moves beyond the threshold, even inside its validity window. Without a threshold one gap on a pair eats a month of margin, and that is provider practice, not our caution.
owner.tariff.quote.title: Quote and tolerance
owner.tariff.readonly.body: Changing these values requires versioning in the domain: a deal must keep for ever the version in force when it was opened. An input form over a constant would give you a button that repricing already opened deals.
owner.tariff.readonly.title: Read only for now
owner.tariff.subtitle: The values in force and what follows from them. Rate, fixed part, conversion markup, quote drift threshold and who pays the fee.
owner.tariff.title: Pricing and markup
owner.tariff.tolerance.note: The amount tolerance applies only if it was disclosed to the party before payment. An undisclosed tolerance cannot be declared after the fact, so the effective tolerance without a disclosure is zero.
owner.vat.note: The VAT regime is shown, not an amount. The form of the tax depends on an open question about the tax base, and a tax computed just in case would become a fact of the system before it is an answer from the tax office.
profile.data.body: You can export everything we hold about you and request deletion. Data on closed deals must be kept for a set period — we delete it once that expires.
profile.data.title: your data
profile.review.note: Once a year we must review client data. We remind you in advance — a deal will not stop over it if you answer in time.
profile.sessions.body: The device, country and time of every sign-in. The current one is marked.
profile.sessions.revokeAll: End all sessions except the current one
profile.sessions.title: Devices and sessions
profile.subtitle: The identity check is done once and works for all your deals in any role.
profile.title: Profile
requisites.change.blocked.P-01: There are no details yet: add them first.
requisites.change.blocked.P-03: You need an account in your own name first. While the holder differs, saving is impossible.
requisites.change.blocked.P-04: Confirm the code from the test transfer first.
requisites.change.blocked.P-07: Funds are reserved for deal {deal}. You may request a change, but the payout will be paused for the cooling-off period.
requisites.change.blocked.P-09: A cooling-off period from the previous change is running. A second change is not accepted until it ends.
requisites.change.blocked.P-10: Less than 72 hours to settlement. The change is blocked automatically and a case has been opened.
requisites.history.confirm.code: Confirmed with the code from the test transfer
requisites.holderName.why: The name comes from your identity check and cannot be edited: the account must be in your name, and we do not allow even an attempt to enter someone else.
requisites.notMe.body: Press it and the request is cancelled at once, restoring the previous details. We also open an incident and hold the payout until it is reviewed.
requisites.notMe.title: Did someone else request this?
requisites.notified: Who is notified: you, the other party to the deal, our operator. Channels: email, message, cabinet.
requisites.state.P-01.body: Without payout details there can be no payout. The holder name is taken from your identity check — you neither need nor can enter it.
requisites.state.P-01.title: No details yet
requisites.state.P-03.body: This is a hard stop, not a warning: a payout can only go to an account whose holder matches your identity check. There is no “save anyway” button. If the account really is yours, write to us and we will review it by hand.
requisites.state.P-03.title: The account is not in your name
requisites.state.P-04.body: We sent a small amount with a code in the reference. Enter the code — it confirms both the account and its holder. Attempts left: {attempts}.
requisites.state.P-04.title: A test transfer has been sent
requisites.state.P-06.body: The account is confirmed by the test transfer and the holder matches your identity check. You may change them, but a change starts a cooling-off period and pauses the payout.
requisites.state.P-06.title: Details are verified
requisites.state.P-07.body: Funds are reserved for deal {deal}, so the details are read-only. A change is possible, but it triggers re-verification, a cooling-off period and a notice to all parties, and the payout is barred for that time.
requisites.state.P-07.title: Details are locked by a reservation
requisites.state.P-09.body: The change was accepted but does not take effect immediately. While it runs, the payout is barred and all parties have been notified on every channel.
requisites.state.P-09.title: Cooling-off period is running
requisites.state.P-10.body: The form will not open: changing payout details in the last 72 hours before settlement is impossible. A case has already been opened automatically; its number is in your correspondence.
requisites.state.P-10.title: Changes are blocked until settlement
requisites.subtitle: This is a security perimeter, not a form. Swapped payout details are the most common way money is stolen in a deal, so everything here is slow, announced to both sides, and never instant.
requisites.test.howItWorks: We send a small amount to this account with a code in the payment reference. This verifies both the account and that it is yours.
requisites.test.notArrived: The transfer is usually visible in the statement within one banking day. If it takes longer, write to us and we will check the sending. It does not affect the deal deadlines.
requisites.test.step.find: Find it in your statement: less than one lari, the code is in the reference
requisites.test.title: Test transfer with a code
requisites.title: Payout details
requisites.why.body: The settlement date, the amount and the parties are known to more people than the deal participants. Swapping the details is the most common way to steal the money: a request to change the account arrives the day before settlement and looks like yours.
requisites.why.note: The change can be cancelled at any time before that period ends — the previous account returns immediately.
requisites.why.symmetry: That is why the account does not change at once: first a re-check, then {hours} hours of waiting, and both sides are notified. If it is you changing it, you lose those hours and nothing else. If it is not you, those hours are enough to cancel everything with one button.
requisites.why.title: why changing the account takes time
security.never.email: We do not send account details by email and do not ask you to confirm them through a link in an email.
security.never.messenger: We do not message you as a staff member and do not run a deal in a messenger.
security.never.otherAccount: We do not ask you to send money to a different account — not «temporarily», not «urgently», not «to a partner account».
security.never.phone: We do not call to dictate account details or a code.
security.never.title: We never do this
security.page.subtitle: Swapped bank details are the most common way money is stolen in a property deal. Here is what protects you and how to reach us.
security.page.title: Security and help
security.report.body: Tell us who contacted you and how. We reply the same business day and pause the settlement if needed.
security.report.note: Reporting breaks nothing and cancels no deal. Better to report for nothing than not to report.
security.report.pause: While we sort it out, operations on the deal can be suspended. This is reversible: our operator lifts the suspension after the check, and the money does not move meanwhile.
security.report.title: Report a suspicious contact
security.rule.channels: We never share bank details by phone, email or messenger.
security.rule.neverAskChange: We never ask you to change payout details urgently.
security.rule.neverAskTransfer: We never ask you to send money to a different account.
security.rule.onlyHere: The only place you see account details is your cabinet.
security.title: What we never do
security.verify.body: Our emails contain no action buttons and no account details. An email says there is an update on a deal and leads to the cabinet — everything else happens there. If an email asks you to do something inside it, the email is not ours.
security.verify.title: How to be sure an email is from us
topup.amounts.title: How much to send
topup.bankFees: Your bank and intermediary banks may deduct their own fee from the transfer — we neither see nor control it.
topup.hidden.body: An amount at an expired or unknown rate must not be shown: you would decide on a figure that no longer exists. It appears after the re-quote.
topup.hidden.label: the amount in the deal currency is hidden
topup.intake.ambiguous.body: The reference was not recognised unambiguously, so the money is held separately and does not count as your deal balance yet. We are sorting it out by hand.
topup.intake.ambiguous.title: The payment is not allocated to the deal
topup.intake.awaiting.body: It usually takes one to three banking days. If your bank has already debited you and nothing is here, write to us and we will find it by the reference.
topup.intake.awaiting.title: The transfer has not arrived yet
topup.intake.exact.body: The reference was recognised and the sender matched you. The money is in your account and remains yours.
topup.intake.exact.title: Credited to your account
topup.intake.insufficient.body: {shortfall} is missing. Send the rest with the same reference. If it is not collected the deal will not start and what you paid in stays in your account.
topup.intake.insufficient.title: Less arrived than needed
topup.intake.overpayment.body: Exactly the deal amount goes to the deal. The excess of {excess} is credited to the free part of your account at once: you can withdraw it at any time.
topup.intake.overpayment.title: More arrived than needed
topup.intake.shortfall_absorbed.body: Intermediary banks took their fee, the difference stays within tolerance and we accepted the amount as full. Nothing needs to be sent.
topup.intake.shortfall_absorbed.title: Slightly less arrived, the difference is within tolerance
topup.intake.unmatched.body: The transfer arrived without a recognised reference, so it is not allocated to the deal and does not count as your balance. With a transfer confirmation from your bank we can identify the payment.
topup.intake.unmatched.title: The payment arrived but was not identified
topup.intake.wrong_currency.body: The money is in your account in the transfer currency. To move on, confirm the rate and the amount: we convert nothing until you confirm.
topup.intake.wrong_currency.title: The transfer arrived in a different currency
topup.method.bank.note: one to three banking days · the main method
topup.method.card.note: Only for small amounts: on this deal amount acquiring would eat it whole.
topup.methods.title: Top-up method
topup.noConversion: The transfer currency matches the deal currency: there is no conversion and no rate is shown here.
topup.payerRule.body: The transfer must come from your own account, in your name. A payment from a spouse, parents or your company is held if it was not agreed in advance.
topup.payerRule.title: the payer rule
topup.quote.expired.body: Amounts in the deal currency are hidden: a figure at a rate that no longer exists must not be shown. We re-quote at the current rate and you see the new amount before confirming.
topup.quote.expired.title: The rate window expired
topup.quote.firm.body: Until the window expires the amount in the deal currency will not change. Send the transfer in time and we credit it at this rate, even if it moves at the bank.
topup.quote.firm.title: The rate is fixed until the window closes
topup.quote.none.body: The transfer currency matches the deal currency. No rate applies and no conversion fee is charged.
topup.quote.none.title: There will be no conversion
topup.quote.unavailable.body: The rate provider is not responding. We do not accept money without a rate, so as not to credit it at an unknown one. Top-up will be available later.
topup.quote.unavailable.title: The rate is temporarily unavailable
topup.quote.voided_by_market_move.body: The market moved beyond the tolerance and the previous rate no longer applies. Amounts in the deal currency are hidden until a re-quote.
topup.quote.voided_by_market_move.title: The market moved, the rate is voided
topup.requisites.note: Account details are never cached: stale details mean a stolen transfer. Check them here before every transfer.
topup.requisites.title: Transfer details
topup.title: Top up your account
trust.boundary: We make the settlement safe. The deal as a whole is made safe by a lawyer, the registry and you.
trust.weDo.1: We hold the money in a nominee account at {bank}, separately from our own funds. It is never used for obligations of other deals.
trust.weDo.2: We execute settlement in favour of the recipient at the moment the registry confirms the transfer of title. If it is not confirmed in time we refund the payer automatically, with no application.
trust.weDo.3: We match the owner from the registry extract against the verified recipient profile by document number — before accepting any money.
trust.weDo.4: We return money only to the account it came from and only in the payer name. We have no other options.
trust.weDo.5: We protect payout details: they are entered only in the cabinet, locked when funds are reserved, and cannot be changed at all in the last 72 hours before settlement.
trust.weDo.6: We record every decision in a log that cannot be amended after the fact. If it comes to a dispute we can show on what grounds and when we acted.
trust.weDo.7: We start a payout only against an evidence bundle: the registry extract, the owner check and the matching of the verified fields. There is no «just pay out» button in the system.
trust.weDo.title: What we do
trust.weDoNot.1: We do not check that a property is clean. We look at the state of the registry as of the extract date — that is not the same thing.
trust.weDoNot.2: We are not liable for third parties challenging the deal.
trust.weDoNot.3: We are not liable for a developer completing construction.
trust.weDoNot.4: We do not present registry and bank timelines as our obligations. Our deadlines are only those that depend on us.
trust.weDoNot.5: We do not insure the risk. We are not an insurance company.
trust.weDoNot.6: We do not promise the recipient that the payer cannot revoke the money before settlement. Until settlement it remains his property.
trust.weDoNot.title: What we do not do
withdraw.amount.title: Amount to withdraw
withdraw.cancel.blocked: Cancelling is possible only while the request is not approved: there is no transition from approved to cancelled in the system.
withdraw.lockedNote: Funds reserved for a deal cannot be withdrawn until the reservation window ends.
withdraw.repeat.blocked: While this withdrawal is running a second request cannot be created. That is how we avoid sending two instructions for the same money.
withdraw.source.body: Only to the account it came from: {account}, {bank}. No other account can be entered — this rule protects you rather than complicating the withdrawal.
withdraw.source.title: Where the money goes
withdraw.state.approved.body: The instruction goes to the bank with the next run. The request can no longer be cancelled once sent.
withdraw.state.approved.title: The withdrawal is approved
withdraw.state.blocked.body: The bank rejected the instruction or a compliance rule fired. The money stayed in the nominee account — it never moved.
withdraw.state.blocked.title: The withdrawal is paused
withdraw.state.cancelled.body: The funds stayed in your account. A new request can be created straight away.
withdraw.state.cancelled.title: The request was cancelled
withdraw.state.paid_out.body: The crediting time depends on your bank. The transfer document is in the documents section.
withdraw.state.paid_out.title: The money was sent to your account
withdraw.state.paying_out.body: The outcome is confirmed against the statement no later than the next banking day.
withdraw.state.paying_out.title: The transfer was sent
withdraw.state.requested.body: We are checking that the source account is known and that there is no active request on it. This usually takes a few minutes.
withdraw.state.requested.title: The withdrawal request was created
withdraw.subtitle: Only to the account the money came from and only in your name. A withdrawal has no other address.
withdraw.title: Withdraw funds
